name: The Conductor's Score
summary: A live orchestral score where each staff is a metric; the Checkout note goes sour, Pulse circles it, and the human gives the cue that retunes it.
look: Ivory score paper with ink staves, note heads and italic serif part names, a teal baton playhead trailing swooping ligatures, and one coral note dropped below the staff on ledger lines with a dashed teal ghost pitch.

components.name: Staves
components.role: one five-line staff per metric, labelled in italic serif

components.name: Number-notes
components.role: note heads with the metric value as the lyric

components.name: Baton playhead
components.role: teal line with a trailing swooping ligature

components.name: Dissonance ring
components.role: coral circle and ledger lines around the sour note

components.name: Ghost pitch
components.role: dashed teal note head showing where the value should be

components.name: Conductor's cue + final barline
components.role: the human decision, then 'fine.' as the CTA

motion.name: On-beat pops
motion.how: notes scale 1→1.15→1 (0.12 s up, 0.2 s down) as the playhead crosses; one bar = 2 s at 120 BPM

motion.name: Baton ligature
motion.how: swoop path draws along the baton's trail and fades, power2.out 0.6 s, landing on a downbeat

motion.name: Retune
motion.how: sour note wobbles ±4° for two 8ths, then slides to the ghost pitch with elastic.out(1, 0.5) in 0.6 s on the cue

story: Hook: '38 dashboards. Nobody conducting.' An overcrowded 38-part score, one grey note 'heard: Fri 17:40'. Reveal: a teal baton ligature swoops across the title page and lands on the drop; 'Acme Pulse — conducted, every minute'. Proof: the playhead sweeps four staves; at bar 12 the Checkout note sinks below the staff, circled coral with '−18% · since 09:42 · deploy #2231', and on the human's cue (Roll back) it slides back to pitch. CTA: final teal chord, double barline, 'Every metric. Every minute.', 'fine.', Start free.
adapt: Give each of your signals its own staff (queues, regions, customers, costs) and let the playhead be your product's run or sync cycle.

references.note: conductor movement visualised as motion graphics

fit.risk: With sound off the sour-note gag must read visually; drop the note well below the staff, wobble it and turn it coral.
